cohort_rule: The first 14 complete weekday CME trading sessions beginning 2025-03-27, fixed before inspecting labels or model outcomes.
sampling: First clean target-contract F_LAST event in each UTC minute
label_rule: At/after decision+60s, first clean two-sided target-contract mid strictly before 16:00 UTC and within the same CME session; up at >=+1 tick, down at <=-1 tick, otherwise neutral.
quality_rule: Reject the entire cohort on a missing/degraded source day, invalid dated 6EM5 mapping, incomplete DBN/Zstd, source hash mismatch, target book reconstruction or timestamp error, or locked/crossed eligible decision/label book. No successful-subset training.

trainer.preprocessing: train-only mean/population standard deviation; clip standardized channels to +/-10
trainer.test_use: One evaluation after weights and preprocessing are frozen
